title: Meta Shares Rise After Open Sourcing a Powerful AI To Compete With Chinese Models
key_facts: Meta will open-source Muse Spark 1.2, one of its most powerful AI models, as it competes with Chinese models.
CEO Mark Zuckerberg announced it in a lengthy essay, which also said Meta will release several open-source models called Muse Glimmer.
Meta shares were up almost 2 percent after the announcement and before markets opened.
Meta shares have fallen about 10 percent so far this year after second-quarter earnings, when investors scrutinised capital spending of up to $145 billion this year.
Zuckerberg urged Washington to reduce rules on training data that he says make American open-source models slower to improve.
Sen. Bernie Sanders, a US senator, called on three big US AI companies, including Meta, to pause AI development.
